from pathlib import Path

def replace_once(path: str, old: str, new: str) -> None:
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text()
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected one match, got {count}: {old[:80]!r}')
    p.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
